name: Tray.ai
description: Tray.ai (the Tray Platform) is an enterprise orchestration platform that unifies data integration, workflow automation, and AI agent development with governed MCP tooling.
best_for: Enterprise teams deploying AI agents across departments who need integration, automation, and governed Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling in one platform.
features: Merlin Agent Builder for building conversational or autonomous AI agents
700+ pre-built connectors across CRM, marketing, finance, HR, and analytics systems
Visual workflow canvas (Tray Build) and code-native development (Tray Headless)
Agent Gateway providing managed MCP servers with 700+ connectors exposed as governed tools
Audit trails, observability, and role-based access control across all agent actions
SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance
